{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data to ensure clean state
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates based on patient_id
print("Duplicate patient_id count:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check how many times each patient appears
df_grouped = df.groupby('patient_id').size()
print("Patient visit counts:", df_grouped.value_counts().to_dict())

# Identify the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
max_sample_seq = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check that we now have one row per patient
print("Number of unique patients after filtering:", len(max_sample_seq))
print("Number of unique patient_id values:", len(df['patient_id'].unique()))

# Now filter for SEVERE disease
severe_df = max_sample_seq[max_sample_seq['severity'] == 'SEVERE']

# Check how many SEVERE cases there are
print("Number of SEVERE patients:", len(severe_df))

# Calculate mean baseline biomarker
mean_biomarker_severe = severe_df['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

mean_biomarker_severe"}
